title: Reject incomplete parents before reconciling competing story definitions
preconditions: Use merged checkout story revisions r2-a and r2-b descended from r1; each branch definition is complete and distinct.

steps.action: Submit full revision r3 with only r2-a as parent using story revise; query requirements/history afterward.
steps.expected_result: The operation is rejected, expected heads identify both r2-a and r2-b, and no r3 record is visible.

steps.action: Submit full r3 with both current heads as parents and reload the story.
steps.expected_result: No revision conflict remains and current revision is r3.
Both former heads and original r1 remain visible unchanged, with r3 naming both parents.

expected_result: Reconciliation consumes every current head while preserving the competing histories.
